title: Abstract art: Kandinsky and Mondrian
subtitle: 1910s-1920s
subject: art
description: For the first time, a painting no longer represents anything of the visible world. **Kandinsky** frees forms; **Mondrian** reduces everything to geometry.

hero.hook: What if a painting no longer needed to tell the story of the world to move people?

blocks.text: In the years **1910** and **1920**, abstraction broke the oldest rule of painting: , the obligation to represent the visible world. The table is no longer a window: it is an autonomous object. [[mimesis]]
Two parallel quests: **Wassily Kandinsky** translates the soul through free forms; **Piet Mondrian** seeks the laws of the universe in pure geometry.

**Wassily Kandinsky** (1866-1944), Russian lawyer turned painter, settled in Munich. Around **1910**, returning home at dusk, he is overwhelmed by a painting whose subject he does not recognize. It's one of his, upside down. The resemblance to reality then appears to him as an obstacle.

blocks.caption: Around 1910, Kandinsky took the step towards abstraction.

blocks.text: Gifted with synesthesia, he said he “heard” colors and “see” sounds. Hence its titles: Compositions, Improvisations.

In **1911**, he published *Spirituality in Art* and theorized the . Each color has a vibration: blue evokes the celestial; yellow, more aggressive, can “sound” like a trumpet. Painting must act on the soul like music, without narrative. [[lyrical abstraction]]

The Dutchman **Piet Mondrian** (1872-1944) arrives at abstraction through a slow  of reality. Between **1908** and **1912**, his series of trees show the trunk and branches which disappear in favor of a framework of lines. [[decantation]]

blocks.caption: From the tree to the network of lines: Mondrian simplifies it down to the essential.

blocks.text: He often asked to sit with his back to the window in restaurants, so as not to see trees and gardens which he considered too disorderly.

In **1917**, he founded the **De Stijl** movement and theorized **neoplasticism**: reducing art to the elements of the cosmos. All that remains is the straight line and the three primary colors. The right angle must reflect the balance of universal forces, far from individual emotions. He even banned green from his studio, considered too “natural”.

Abstraction does not stay in the museum. At , a school of architecture and applied arts founded by  in **1919**, painters, architects and designers collaborate. Kandinsky teaches there; Mondrian's aesthetic inspires plans and facades. [[Bauhaus]] [[Walter Gropius]]

blocks.caption: The Bauhaus: when abstract art meets design and architecture.

blocks.text: At the Bauhaus, Kandinsky had his students associate shapes and colors. He concluded: yellow triangle, red square, blue circle.
Modern design is born: “form follows function”. Gerrit Rietveld's famous Red and Blue chair seems like a 3D Mondrian. Mondrian found that the real object broke the purity of abstraction.

Without a story to tell, the painting invites the viewer to project their own meaning. This freedom opens up the , where the idea takes precedence over the material. After the wars, abstraction also says what figuration can no longer convey. [[Conceptual Art]]

Abstract art is born in two ways: Kandinsky frees the forms to express the soul; Mondrian geometrizes the world to aim for the universal.
